text:
Weekly review. The market light is YELLOW (VIX 18.6, S&P below its 50-day average), so the engine is buying at half size, A-grade setups only. Nasdaq futures are +1.3% this morning. 9 trading days left, but everything must be sold by Fri Oct 23.
SELL ALL at the open: CRWD (below its 8% stop), SNOW and AMD (both rotated out of the top 5). A tech bounce at the open is a good time to exit.
Leadership has rotated from AI hardware and cyber to Financials, Healthcare and Energy: V, MA, ABBV, MSFT, XOM.
Engine buys V, MA and ABBV. V and MA are the same trade (card networks), so I'd use XOM (Energy, #5) in place of MA to spread across 3 sectors.
Deadline rules for this week: about $650 per name, -4% stop, take profit at +4%, sell everything by Fri Oct 23. All earnings dates are after Oct 23 (V Oct 27, ABBV Oct 30, XOM Oct 30). Fed decision Oct 28.
The research run found that none of the tested rule changes held up out-of-sample. The edge mostly disappears when trades happen a day later, so expect modest results.
You -3.1%, system simulated -9.7%, S&P -1.1% since Sep 28.
